object.attr: as implemented: mapped from the existing tests. A write tool call that names a missing document doesn't meet this requirement. The call raises, and an agent sees a protocol error with no ok or error_type. test_new_object_unknown_doc_raises asserts the raise. See the gaps.
object.description: Make write tool calls that fail: new_object with an attribute the document doesn't declare, set_attribute with a value that isn't an option, create_document with the ID of an existing document, update_object naming a missing object, and set_figure with a file that isn't SVG. Expected: each result has ok false, an error message that names the problem, and an error_type.
